description: Header file defining CUDA tunable GEMM parameter structures, enums, and utility functions for PyTorch integration, including classes for GEMM parameters, strided batched GEMM, scaled GEMM, and related functions.

classes.name: GemmParams
classes.description: Structure holding parameters for GEMM operations, including matrix sizes, types, and memory pointers.

classes.name: GemmAndBiasParams
classes.description: Structure for GEMM with bias and activation, including parameters for bias, activation, and types.

classes.name: GemmStridedBatchedParams
classes.description: Parameters for batched GEMM with striding, supporting multiple matrices and batch size.

classes.name: ScaledGemmParams
classes.description: Parameters for scaled GEMM operations, including scaling factors and types.

methods.name: BLASTypeName
methods.description: Returns string name for given scalar type.

methods.name: ScalarTypeToBLASType
methods.description: Converts c10::ScalarType to corresponding BLAS type string.

methods.name: ComputeTypeFor
methods.description: Returns compute type string based on template type.

methods.name: to_string_epilogue
methods.description: Converts GEMM activation epilogue enum to string.

methods.name: NumericalCheck
methods.description: Checks numerical closeness of two tensors for validation.
